front.title: Principles for Web Traffic Management by Intermediaries

abstract.t:
This document describes principles for web intermediaries that balance security needs with open web accessibility.
About This Document
This note is to be removed before publishing as an RFC.
The latest revision of this draft can be found at https://thibmeu.github.io/draft-bcp-civil/draft-meunier-bcp- civil.html. Status information for this document may be found at https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-meunier-bcp-civil/.
Source for this draft and an issue tracker can be found at https://github.com/thibmeu/draft-bcp-civil.
